road_structure: segment with a front hazard or slow-moving target ahead
Inattention to the road ahead.interaction_pattern: ego fails to respond in time to an abnormal target directly ahead

Failure to yield.interaction_pattern: the yielding vehicle fails to give way to a priority vehicle and cuts through the conflict zone

road_structure: segment with an explicit speed limit
Speeding.interaction_pattern: vehicle speed clearly exceeds the current road speed limit

Failure to maintain safe following dista.interaction_pattern: following vehicle keeps too small a longitudinal gap and creates rear-end risk when the lead decelerates

Wrong-way driving.interaction_pattern: vehicle travels against the permitted direction and forms an oncoming conflict

Illegal lane change.interaction_pattern: vehicle cuts into an adjacent lane and squeezes the target-lane vehicle

Illegal overtaking.interaction_pattern: vehicle overtakes a leading vehicle and forms a dangerous conflict with oncoming or overtaken traffic
